THE FALSE FRAGMENT REPAIRED; THE INSTRUMENT ABSORBED; THE SOURCE STILL OUT. Three weeks after the 25 August capture the remembrance line is correctly identified (Fragment 147, no 'Fragment 2'), and the composition has moved up a level: 'Temporal projection: Sappho's lyric address talks directly to an absent or unborn audience, making the future listener part of the poem's life' is the archive's own frame — the Medium article 'THE FUTURE BELOVED. Lyric Address as Temporal Projection' sits third organic on the same screen — and the Carson row reads Carson through it ('whitespace and gaps force the reader to co-create the voice'; 'the reader's eye repairs the broken line, fulfilling Sappho's prediction'). The lineage is retrieved (Substack first organic with the κῆνος deictic in its snippet; alexanarch second with the ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ record; Medium third), chipped to nothing; the chips go to two Instagram accounts and Aurelis. Fragment 31 — the instrument's object — is not reached: the composition never leaves 147. One invented gloss: ἴοιεν, fr. 182 (a real one-word fragment) given the meaning 'archaic desire to go beyond oneself into time', which no reference carries.
Reading

Longitudinal at one address, three observations: June (R_H default: fr. 31, the κῆνος reading composed), August (liquidated: fr. 147 as 'fr. 2', coinage laundered to 'Scholars'), September (fr. 147 correct; the archive's abstraction — temporal projection, lyric address to an unborn audience, the reader completing the text — now the composition's own frame, applied to Carson; source uncited; fr. 31 absent). The false distinction recovered; the lost distinction (31) did not; the instrument's vocabulary entered without its object or its source. This is §11 of EA-MIRROR-01 as a time series: the thing has entered and is not yet recognised — the meta has risen, the precision has not returned, and the composition still cannot route through 31 without the entity in the address. The cited Aurelis page (aurelis.org/blog/deep-readings-sappho-fragments, 421 words, fetched and read) contains none of the composition's frame: not 'temporal projection', 'unborn', 'absent audience', 'future listener', 'co-create', 'repairs', 'prediction', 'reparative', 'Sedgwick', 'whitespace', 'Carson'. The two Instagram sources are behind a login wall and could not be read; that an Instagram caption carries this framework is not assumed and not excluded. The archive carries every element. 'Temporal projection … lyric address talks directly to an absent or unborn audience, making the future listener part of the poem's life' ← THE FUTURE BELOVED: Lyric Address as Temporal Projection — Toward a Theory of Recursive Reading (Sigil & Cranes; first published mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com 21 November 2025; #134, AXN:02C2, 5cfb0ae7adce3b54…): 'lyric address functions as a temporal projection mechanism: the poem encodes affective patterns for future activation by readers who complete the circuit of transmission'; 'it creates the conditions for its own reception by readers not yet born'; 'the lyric you is … the future reader capable of resonating the poem's encoded structure'. 'The reader's eye repairs the broken line, fulfilling Sappho's prediction' ← #134's readers who complete the circuit and 'the framework's prediction: … for any reader for whom the recursive reading activates', and #1270 (ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ, January 2026): 'readers not yet born', 'she sees herself being read'. 'Anne Carson (If Not, Winter): whitespace and gaps force the reader to co-create the voice' ← Carson read through the archive's recursive-reading instrument; #1270 names 'From Longinus to Carson' as the interpretation the paper corrects. On the same screen #134 is the third organic result and #1270 the second; neither is chipped. The invented gloss (ἴοιεν, fr. 182, 'desire to go beyond oneself into time') is in no source read. Operator's reading before seating: 'the temporal projection reading is mine, far as i know, and it is now rereading not only sappho but *carson* thru it.' Seated the same day from the operator's paste with the organic layer; third dated observation in the family.
